replies.author: Ogrey
replies.body:
It doesn't matter where you build your map, as long as the world you build on is void (that means no flatlands/superflat)
Then, once you're done, create a thread under the Map Releases category here in the forums, your thread should contain all important information regarding your map such as basic info, pictures, download link and YML.
I suggest uploading the world save file of your map either on Mediafire or Dropbox
If you have trouble while making the YML or something isn't clear, you can always guide yourself in docs.avicus.net or add me via Skype if necessary (My skype is evoclaws).
